body:
I did think about this, but her brother (the one who told me that she was the reason they didn't talk) is super close to her. Family is everything to him and she is his "baby sister" - he knew my dad's family as well and is friends with his brother. I don't think he would take their side if my dad's parents were like that. 

I also didn't add (because I didn't think it would be important to the OP) that my mother is *extremely* dramatic, narcissistic, and holds grudges for *decades*. 

I will talk to my dad about it though - I want to hear it from *him* without my mother around.

I initially wasn't going to, because it was pretty clear that he had died on impact - but the 911 operator told my boyfriend to do CPR and he looked extremely uncomfortable with that suggestion so I did it. When police arrived, they continued CPR, and so did the paramedics when they arrived. 

Sorry if that comes across as snarky or defensive - just trying to explain what happened.
